messages:
Aisha: Hey @Lina, quick sync — customer NewHaven wants to POC an in-house model (newhaven-13b-qlora) behind our Dedicated offering. They asked about KV cache compatibility and whether we support fp16/4-bit QLoRA variants.
Jordan: Yep, we ran a compatibility scan earlier — QLoRA variants work but need quantization profile v2 and KV cache alignment; sequence length 2048 is fine with our runtime.
Lina: Great. What are the blockers for running on Redwood Dedicated? Security wants KMS + audit logs and legal wants data residency.
Maya: We can support KMS + HSM via our Private offering. For Dedicated we'll surface token-level audit logs and can do contract addendum for retention controls. Need SOC2 evidence and an executed DPA.
Ravi: Ops note — model size with 4-bit quantization still needs ~32GB GPU memory for reasonable batch sizes. If they want autoscaling bursts we'll need to reserve extra capacity; that affects pricing.
Aisha: Pricing question from procurement: do we charge extra for a custom variant vs using our verified catalog model? Lina: They prefer a predictable monthly commit.
Jordan: We can give two options: 1) Dedicated reserved pool with an add-on for custom-variant onboarding ($X/mo + onboarding fee). 2) Use Hosted with variant pinned to a Customer Variant slot (higher token price). I'll draft numbers.
Lina: Also security asked about model provenance — do you verify weights?
Maya: We perform a lightweight fingerprint and compatibility scan but don't do a full weights provenance attestation by default. We can run an elevated onboarding review (takes ~5 business days) and produce a security checklist artifact.
Aisha: Customer asked about rollback/rollout controls if the variant regresses.
Jordan: Redwood Console supports canary rollouts + automatic fallback to a verified catalog model. We can set a 10% canary for 24 hours and auto-fallback on quality alerts.
Lina: Can you share a sample onboarding config and the CLI command they'd run to push the variant?
Jordan: Sure — sample below:
```
redwood variant upload --name newhaven-13b-qlora --file s3://nh-models/newhaven-13b-qlora.tar.gz \
  --quantization qlora-4bit-v2 --kv-cache-enabled true --sequence-length 2048 
redwood deploy dedicated --pool nh-dedicated --variant newhaven-13b-qlora --commit 2k-hours
```
Maya: Also add `--kms-key arn:aws:kms:...` flag for encrypted artifacts.
Ravi: For Dedicated sizing, suggest GPU type A40x2 (or equivalent) and a reserve of 2 nodes for bursts. That maps to estimated monthly $Y committed.
Aisha: I'll route the legal and procurement asks. Lina — would you like us to start an elevated onboarding review now or after contract?
Lina: Please start now — procurement timeline is tight.
Jordan: Copy. I'll kick off the onboarding scan and attach the compatibility report here once done.
deploy-bot: onboarding-scan queued for newhaven-13b-qlora (scan id: ONB-8934). ETA ~2h :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Aisha: Thanks team — I'll follow up with a one-pager for procurement and link to the pricing options.
Lina: Thanks, we appreciate the quick turnaround! :pray:
